arguments.summary: A data exfiltration attempt was detected from workstation WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) in the Finance department. The endpoint used DNS tunneling via high-entropy TXT queries to the domain ns1.exfil-c2.example.com, resolving to IP 203.0.113.77. The exfiltration signature matched Iodine DNS tunneling patterns. Correlation revealed prior Cobalt Strike beaconing from another finance workstation (WS-FIN-042) to the same C2 domain. The threat actor likely gained initial access via WS-FIN-042 and attempted lateral movement. Although no malware was found on WS-FIN-019, the outbound C2 IP and domain were confirmed malicious through historical IDS alerts. Immediate firewall blocking was enforced. No data loss was confirmed, but the incident indicates a potential breach in the finance network segment.
